what.question: How can a group find a time for a meetup or team meeting?
what.answer: Create date and time options in Time2Gather and share the link. Everyone selects when they are available, then you compare the results and confirm a plan. It is free for friend groups, study groups, and team meetings.

login.question: Can I create and join a poll without signing up or installing an app?
login.answer: Yes. Hosts and participants only need to enter a name, with no registration or social sign-in. Create meetings and vote in a web browser on your phone or computer.

location.question: Can we vote on where to meet too?
location.answer: Yes. Enable location voting when creating the meeting and add options. Participants can vote for preferred locations and discuss plans in the comments.
